title: Corrupted palm
body:
Description

The Corrupted Palm is a tree exclusive to the 2025 Halloween Event, and is found in the Corrupt Biome. Bomb fruit grow on this tree, which can make it dangerous to cut down.

Obtaining (Outside of Corrupt Biome)

Take either a Palm or King Palm to the Uncertainty Cave and let it be hit by one of the mushroom's spores, it will turn into the corrupted palm tree.

Disclaimer! ⚠️

If the tree gets hit once it will turn into Corrupted Palm, but if its hit again, it ill turn into regular Corrupted wood. This process is irreversible.

Trivia:

It has a unique Rplank texture!
